# @arki/geo

> Geospatial toolkit: coordinate and distance maths that run anywhere, geocoding with provider fallback and a cache, and React hooks and Google Maps components.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/geo`: Main exports (server-side + shared). `AddressNotFound`, `BoundsError`, `CONVERSION_FACTORS`, `EARTH_RADIUS_KM`, `EARTH_RADIUS_MI`, `GeoError`, `GeocodingCancelled`, `InvalidCoordinates`, `MapProviderError`, `NoAddressAtLocation`, `ProviderRateLimited`, `ProviderRejected`; and 39 more.
- `@arki/geo/react`: Client-side exports (React hooks and components). `AddressNotFound`, `BoundsError`, `CONVERSION_FACTORS`, `EARTH_RADIUS_KM`, `EARTH_RADIUS_MI`, `GeoError`, `GeocodingCancelled`, `InvalidCoordinates`, `MapProviderError`, `NoAddressAtLocation`, `ProviderRateLimited`, `ProviderRejected`; and 45 more.
- `@arki/geo/geocoding`: `GEOCODING_PROVIDERS`, `GeocodingService`, `addressComponentsSchema`, `createGeocodingService`, `geocodeResultSchema`, `geocodingEnv`; types `AddressComponents`, `BatchGeocodeEntry`, `GeocodeOutcome`, `GeocodeResult`, `GeocodingCache`, `GeocodingConfig`; and 3 more.
- `@arki/geo/react/google-maps`: Google Maps integration. `COLOR_SETS`, `DEFAULT_BOUNDS_PADDING`, `DEFAULT_MAP_CENTER`, `DEFAULT_MAP_CONFIG`, `DEFAULT_MAP_ID`, `DEFAULT_MAP_ZOOM`, `GoogleInfoWindow`, `GoogleMap`, `GoogleMapsProvider`, `GoogleMarker`, `GooglePin`, `HIGHLIGHTED_BOUNDS_PADDING`; and 63 more.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Start here
- [README](README.md): quick start, geocoding, failures and limits.

## By task
- Distance and coordinates: the root entry `@arki/geo`.
- Address to coordinates: `geocode`, `reverseGeocode`, `batchGeocode` from `@arki/geo/geocoding`.
- Maps in the browser: `@arki/geo/react` and `@arki/geo/react/google-maps`.

## Rules that bite
- Failures are returned, not thrown. Check them with `.is(value)`: `AddressNotFound`, `NoAddressAtLocation`, `ProviderRateLimited`, `ProviderUnreachable`, `ProviderRejected`, `GeocodingCancelled`, `InvalidCoordinates`.
- `geocode` tries the next provider when one finds nothing. Missing addresses and failures are not cached.
- Distance is straight-line haversine on a sphere, error up to about 0.5%. No routing.
- `react`, `react-dom` and `@vis.gl/react-google-maps` are optional peers for the React entries.
